  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.

Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.

Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test – Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills.
  • Versant English Proficiency Test – Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency. AC1 or C2 level is required.

Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding. Please register on our internal job platform, XConnect, and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament.

This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organisational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Vem fazer parte do Time IDG

Somos uma organização social privada sem fins lucrativos, especializada em gerir centros culturais públicos de grande importância para o país e programas ambientais.Atualmente, também prestamos consultorias para a concepção, modelagem, formatação e gestão de projetos, desenvolvendo o escopo, fazendo a captação de recursos, o enquadramento nas leis de incentivo e gerindo sua implementação.

O Paço do Frevo , localizado no coração do Recife, é mais do que um museu; é um guardião do patrimônio mundial da humanidade, celebrando a riqueza e a diversidade de nossa cultura.

O Museu do Amanhã , uma fascinante instituição de ciências no Rio de Janeiro, convida você a refletir sobre nossas ações presentes e seu impacto no amanhã, inspirando mudanças para um futuro melhor.

O Museu das Favelas em São Paulo é um espaço de resiliência e criatividade das comunidades, revelando a potência e o brilho das favelas através de suas histórias e expressões culturais únicas.

O Museu do Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro é uma viagem encantadora pelo mundo da botânica, convidando você a explorar a beleza e a importância das plantas em nossas vidas.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CultSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual,Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias , implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Com experiências imersivas e coletivas, irá reunir as muitas Amazônias, nacionais e internacionais, e aproximar os vários setores sociais para debater os temas da área.

Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um.Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus.Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós! Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

title: Assist Driller
description:
Overview

  • Assist the Driller in operating drilling and mud circulating equipment as instructed in the well program and in accordance to Company policies and procedures.
  • Actively promote Transocean Shared Values.

Resumo do Perfil do Cargo

  • Assist the Driller in operating drilling and mud circulating equipment as instructed in the well program and in accordance to Company policies and procedures.
  • Actively promote Transocean Shared Values.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Qualified applicants are considered for and treated during employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Reporting

Reports to: Driller

Supervision

Derrickhand, Pumphand, and Floorhand, Rover

Pre-requisite/Qualification

  • High School Diploma (U.S.)/ Proof of Completion of Formal Education or Relevant Craft Certificate (where applicable)
  • Successful Military Discharge – Preferred for U.S.
  • Graduate of Trade School or University where knowledge and training acquired are applicable to job requirements – Preferred
  • Valid medical examination and vaccination certificates
  • Knowledge of all technical calculations required for the safe operation within the drilling operations.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid well control certificate per the standard defined on the training matrix.

General Requirements

  • Promotes a Safe and Respectful Work Environment: Proactively promotes and Maintains a healthy respect for open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel.
  • Demonstrates care for the safety and well-being of all personnel, at all times. Invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement of those qualified, to fulfill their career objectives. Respects the dignity of all personnel and recognizes their merit.
  • Attend and participate in all required Safety and Operational meetings.
  • Participate fully in the annual performance appraisal process, competency assessments based on performance against Operational Discipline requirements.
  • Complete company training requirements for the Assistant Driller job level as per the training matrix, including in local/regulatory requirements.
  • If applicable, the duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position must be observed.
  • Full participation in emergency drills and respond to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.
  • Norway Specific: Responsible to follow up on the working environment within the rig department.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • This is inclusive of:
    • Understanding and perform the roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre-job meeting.
    • Understanding the hazards associated with the task.
    • Understanding and effectively implementing the control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
    • Execute all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
    • Recognize at risk behavior or conditions during tasks and call ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure, or when the job does not go as planned.
    • Participate in After Action Reviews to feedback lessons learned from performing the task.

HSE Requirements

  • Demonstrate commitment and leadership in the protection of personnel, the environment, and assets.
  • Coach personnel in the understanding of applicable Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Ensure work is executed in accordance with Company OI & HSE requirements.
  • Call a Time Out when a real or perceived at risk behavior or unsafe condition is observed.
  • Coach personnel to use WorkSight ENGAGE during the execution of planned work.
  • Use WorkSight COACH during the execution of planned work and daily operations to reinforce Company requirements.
  • Report all incidents, potential hazards, or abnormal situations. Ensure reported situations are acknowledged properly.
  • Ensure the Control of Work process is complied with when planning and managing the execution of work.
  • Ensure major accident barriers / controls are maintained.
  • Ensure safe and organized work areas are maintained.
  • Understand your role in an emergency, as designated in the Emergency Response Plan and Station Bill.
  • Lead or participate in all emergency drills and exercises, as required.
  • Ensure change is properly controlled and managed.

    • Duties

    The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements. When considering assignment of duties for the Assistant Driller, the Supervisor and the Assistant Driller will apply the rules of task planning (CAKES) to determine if the assigned role is appropriate. This means confirming that the individuals involved have the knowledge, skills, and experience to carry out the task, and the task plan complies with policy before they are authorized to proceed.

    Operations/Maintenance

    GENERAL DUTIES

    • Perform the drilling department’s daily checklists, i.e. QHSE checks, Derrick inspection, choke and mud manifold line ups, etc.
    • Maintain accurate BHA record of tubular and tool dimensions (i.e. internal and external diameter, fish neck, handling profiles and serial numbers etc.).
    • Calculate ton-miles on drilling line; maintain an accurate logbook and advise the Driller on the need to slip and cut.
    • Maintain an organized drilling equipment store and tubular and subs inventory.
    • Maintain proper communication with the Driller, Toolpusher, and other department heads.
    • Read and interpret various gauges and meters relating to the drilling operations; assist the Driller in maintaining records and logs.
    • Actively participate in pre-tour meeting with the drilling crew for all drilling operations.
    • Assist and relieve the Driller at the Driller’s console during drilling operations.
    • Assist with the preparation of equipment for impending drilling operations.
    • Organize and supervise the drilling crews for all operations.
    • Assist the Driller during an emergency or well control situation; assist in the well killing operations.
    • Assist in supervision of Preventive Maintenance carried out on drilling equipment.
    • Assist in supervision of repairs on drilling and associated equipment.
    • Assist in running and cementing casing strings, running and retrieving BOPs and risers, and other operations as directed by the Driller or Toolpusher.
    • Monitor mud systems and supervise solids control equipment and mud mixing operation.
    • Assist in the planning, organization and execution of rig move operations.
    • Operate drilling and associated equipment as directed by the Driller, i.e. Top Drive System, mud pumps, BOP and Diverter controls, etc.
    • Know the clients’ rules and Company procedures for well control and blowout prevention.
    • Incorporate the THINK process into all tasks, whether working alone or as part of a team.
    • Participate daily in START process.
    • Ensure subordinate personnel are properly trained in the START process.
    • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) whenever an unplanned hazard or a change in the expected results is observed.
    • Ensure all relevant safety procedures and practices are adhered to during drilling operations, in accordance to the Company QHSE manual.
    • Report any incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to the Driller or Toolpusher.
    • Actively participate in weekly safety meetings and pre-tour meetings as required, FOCUS Improvement Process, and all other Company safety management systems.
    • Assist in conducting drilling operations safety drills as and when required.
    • Demonstrate commitment to the Company’s safety policies through leadership and guidance.
    • Ensure that a high standard of hygiene and housekeeping is maintained onboard the rig.
    • Meet the training requirements according to the applicable training matrix.
    • Participate in the annual performance appraisal process.
    • Mentor, coach, develop and train crew members to ensure that they are competent to work at their next job level.
    • Provide leadership and motivation to rig personnel; Apply continuous improvement process.
    • Assist in training to ensure that all personnel are competent to perform their allocated jobs.
    • Promote and maintain a good working relationship with other departments, third-party personnel and Customer Representatives.
    • Assist the Driller with the operation during the running and retrieving of marine risers, BOP and auxiliary equipment.

    Personnel

    • Promote and maintain good working relationships with other departments, third-party personnel and Customer representatives.
    • Ensure all Drilling personnel meet the training requirements as per their applicable training matrix.
    • Mentor, coach, develop and train crew members to ensure they are competent to work at their next job level.
    • Provide leadership and motivation to the drilling crews. Apply continuous improvement process.
    • Assist in training to ensure that all personnel are competent to perform their allocated jobs.
    • Participate fully in the annual performance appraisal process.
    • Apply appropriate accountability regarding recognition; recommend promotion or disciplinary action up to and including discharge.

    Seniority level

    Entry level

    Employment type

    Full-time

    Job function

    Management and Manufacturing

    Industries

    Oil and Gas

title: Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer
description:
Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer

The Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer is responsible for the administration, optimization, and continuous improvement of security technologies, while also serving as a Tier 3 escalation point for complex security incidents. This role bridges advanced incident response with hands‑on engineering of cybersecurity tools, ensuring seamless integration, effective threat detection, and rapid response capabilities. Acting as an extension of external Tier 1 and Tier 2 security operations, the engineer plays a critical role in enhancing the organization’s overall security posture through proactive monitoring, tool fine‑tuning, and strategic incident handling.

Security Tools Administration

  • Administer and optimize security tools, including SIEM, EDR/XDR (Microsoft Defender), firewalls, vulnerability management, email and identity security solutions.
  • Ensure seamless integration of security tools with IT and cloud environments for continuous monitoring and threat detection.
  • Maintain security policies, configurations, and automation rules to improve operational efficiency and reduce false positives.
  • Manage log sources, data ingestion pipelines, and correlation rules within SIEM to enhance security visibility.

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Act as a Tier 3 escalation point for security incidents requiring advanced investigation and resolution.
  • Conduct deep‑dive forensic analysis and threat‑hunting activities to detect and mitigate sophisticated threats.
  • Support the SOC team and external Tier 1 & Tier 2 analysts by providing expertise on complex security incidents.
  • Enhance and refine incident response playbooks, ensuring effective collaboration across all security layers.
  • Align incident response efforts with cybersecurity frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, and ISO 27001.

Threat Intelligence & Vulnerability Management

  • Analyze threat intelligence feeds and proactively adjust defenses based on evolving attack techniques.
  • Coordinate vulnerability assessments, collaborate with IT teams, and track remediation efforts to mitigate risks.
  • Perform proactive threat‑hunting activities to identify potential security gaps before they are exploited.
  • Ensure compliance with patch management policies and security best practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in security tools administration, incident response, or security operations.
  • Experience in listed companies, large‑scale enterprises, or multi‑geographical organizations is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Security solutions.
  • Hands‑on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, firewalls, and security automation tools.
  • Proficiency in threat intelligence, forensic analysis, and malware analysis.
  • Strong understanding of network security, log analysis, and cloud security.
  • Experience with vulnerability management solutions.
  • CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst, or equivalent.
  • Availability to travel internationally.

Soft Skills

  • Problem‑solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working cross‑functionally with IT, cloud, and development teams, as well as external security partners.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Resilient.
  • Willingness to stay current with evolving cybersecurity threats and technologies.
  • Ability to manage multiple security incidents and projects simultaneously.

Our client’s Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft’s Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

The Dynamics CE & Power Platform Senior Technical Architect is a core team member of our client’s customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 centred solutions. The STA will be involved in the business processes and solution design and will be hands on configuring and customising the implementation of Dynamics CE & Power Platform solutions working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The position may require business travel.

Job Location: Silema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

  • A University graduate with relevant degree within a computing or business discipline;
  • Microsoft Dynamics CRM Certifications (2016, D365) AND/OR Power Platform Certifications are desirable;
  • Strong technical & functional knowledge and understanding of Microsoft Dynamics CRM and/or Power Platform technology stack covering a wide spectrum of industries and sectors;
  • Minimum 12+ years of proven experience in IT which includes end to end implementation experience in either of Dynamics CRM / Power Platform solutions;
  • Strong and proven experience in developing solutions that involve Power Platform (including Power Apps like Canvas, Model driven etc., Power Automate, Power BI etc.);
  • Strong understanding of all areas within Customer Engagement including Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Field Services, and Project Service;
  • Good understanding of Dataverse including customisations and development of Business Data Models for different solutions etc.;
  • Good understand of Microsoft Dynamics CRM Accelerators, industry templates and add-ons;
  • Proven track record of successful maintenance or end to end implementation of a number of solutions for medium/ large customers, preferably across a number of business verticals (e.g. healthcare, finance, insurance etc.);
  • Proven ability to develop a clear understanding of clients’ needs and the ability to incorporate them into a solution following effective design approach;
  • Experience of consultancy roles in software delivery;
  • Experience in a delivery-orientated IT environment using waterfall, agile and DevOps methodologies;
  • Adept at business requirement analysis, solution design, development, system verification and deployment strategies;
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and suggest solutions both within and outside the current implementation;
  • Experience in creation of demos, supporting pre-sales activities is an advantage;
  • Business process mapping, Fit Gap analysis, work package estimation, work breakdown structure, modelling and documentation knowledge;
  • Excellent understanding of Dynamics CRM DB Schema and Business Data Model including the customisation and development of Business Data Models for different solutions;
  • Broad understanding of software development lifecycle, development management, release management, data migrations, cut-over planning and hypercare support;
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps & CI/CD is a plus;
  • Knowledge and understanding of .NET framework including extensive experience writing ASP.NET and C# code (not just limited to plugins/custom workflows) is a plus;

Responsibilities

The CE Senior Technical Architect will work with the Consulting Services department to implement various modules of D365 CE (including Power Platform) working closely with client teams and business stakeholders.

  • Organise, execute, manage and document workshops, meetings and requirements sessions with the client representatives, project stakeholders, business analysts and consulting team;
  • Interface effectively with other members of the consulting team to arrive at best in class solution, and provide a sustainable and scalable solution architecture and application to meet client’s requirements;
  • Deliver high quality business and software solutions & services to clients ensuring the implementation of best practices based on Microsoft Dynamics standards and supported configuration/ customizations;
  • Ensure completeness in meeting business requirements and take accountability for project deliverables including and not limited to project documentation, solution design, performance, reliability, testing features etc;
  • Deliver all consultancy and configuration work according to our project methodology, ensuring that all software applications are implemented successfully according to the SLA: on time and on budget;
  • Maximize usage of OOB features and provide technical design or develop/customize solution approach for identified gaps;
  • Contribute to activities as required including technical presales, building demo and proof of concept solutions for various client presentations. Proactively skilling up on new versions and technology stack to be future ready;
  • Work on the creation of Dynamics 365 solutions and industry templates;
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations of business knowledge, skills and behaviour;
  • Be a trusted advisor for our clients and help to provide solutions which can be upgrade ready;
  • Proactively identify business/ project/ technical/ support risks and provide suggestions to mitigate or communicate as necessary;
  • Proactively communicate progress updates to relevant parties both formally and informally;
  • Support practice development activities such as defining, solutioning and configuring industry specific solutions;
  • Be an active member of technical and design working groups within the practice;
  • In all activities, ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory trainings;
  • Drive for process improvement, feature reusability and other initiatives to maximize efficiency in delivery;
  • Carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the management team or supervisors;
  • Provide guidance and mentorship (technical/professional) to groom other team members;

Transformar vidas com saúde é o que nos move!

Atuamos em todo o Brasil por meio de duas unidades de negócios, Amil e Rede Total Care, com mais de 1.500 hospitais credenciados e uma rede própria de hospitais, clínicas, centros de tratamento, home care e transporte médico.

Com uma missão clara e valores sólidos, fortalecemos nossa cultura com compromisso de servir sempre melhor. Cuidamos das nossas pessoas colaboradoras para que esse cuidado se reflita na população que atendemos.

Promovemos uma cultura inovadora, diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Todas as candidaturas qualificadas são bem-vindas, sem distinção de etnia, raça, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, nacionalidade, religião ou qualquer outro marcador social.

Reforçamos que não solicitamos pagamentos, taxas ou códigos SMS em nossos processos seletivos. Todas as oportunidades estão disponíveis em nossos canais oficiais e no nosso site de carreira. Qualquer situação diferente deve ser denunciada.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Engajar, influenciar, negociar e trabalhar em conjunto com sua equipe e com as lideranças das unidades construindo a Cultura de Segurança de pessoas e processos na UHH, sendo exemplo no cumprimento dos requisitos aplicáveis para todos na unidade de atuação.
  • Cumprir com a gestão da rotina da unidade, tais como: NR 32, CIPA, PAE, Brigada de Incêndio, Simulados de Emergência, AVCB, acidentes de trabalho, checklists realizados, treinamentos, PGR – NR 01, PRGS/ PGRSS, etc, acompanhando e reportando os processos de auditoria interna e externa, bem como as visitas e fiscalizações de autoridades públicas.
  • Participar da elaboração e implementar políticas, procedimentos e manuais de Segurança do Trabalho, treinando e capacitando todos os colaboradores sobre os riscos de EHS existentes no ambiente de trabalho e formas de controle.
  • Realizar inspeções nas áreas e ambientes de trabalho, visando identificar perigos, analisar os riscos priorizando os críticos, implementar medidas de controle, usando como base a hierarquia de controle de riscos, bem como preparando relatórios fotográficos para suportar a emissão de laudos técnicos.
  • Apoiar na elaboração, cumprir e controlar a política de EPI nas unidades sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Realizar a gestão e controle dos sistemas de prevenção e combate a incêndio para assegurar que estejam em plenas condições de funcionamento, corretamente instalados e com as análises periódicas dentro da validade e de acordo com o projeto de combate a incêndio da unidade, bem como a execução de todos processos e fluxos de incêndio.
  • Avaliar previamente os requisitos para execução de atividades perigosas (trabalho em altura, eletricidade, espaços confinados, energias perigosas, trabalho a quente, escavação, elevação e suspensão de cargas, etc), elaborando a APR (Analise Preliminar de Risco) e a PT (Permissão do Trabalho) antes do início das atividades e que elas sejam realizadas de acordo com a legislação vigente, com as diretrizes definidas pela UHG e com requisitos de acreditação / certificação e assessment relacionados a área.
  • Participar ativamente de todas as investigações de incidentes e acidentes, com o objetivo de identificar as causas raízes, propor planos de ação para evitar a recorrência, bem como compartilhar os aprendizados, reportando mensalmente os dados de acidentes do trabalho, doenças ocupacionais e agentes insalubres das unidades sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Dar suporte para implementação de todos os projetos de inovação para a melhoria dos processos de Segurança do Trabalho por meio de visitas técnicas, desenvolvimento de controle, levantamento de dados e outras atuações de forma a alavancar resultados da Segurança e das áreas parceiras, tais como meio ambiente, saúde e qualidade de vida nas suas unidades.
  • Realizar a gestão de documentação e atividades perigosas das subcontratadas ao que tange diretrizes de Segurança do Trabalho, controlando a documentação e inspecionando as atividades, a fim de buscar a padronização nos documentos e dos processos.

Qualificações Necessárias

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho com registro no Ministério do Trabalho;
  • Desejável Formação em Bombeiro Civil;
  • Vivência desejável: de 2 anos ou mais na área de atuação (hospitalar, call center, etc);
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencial na Unidade Hospitalar de Segunda à Quinta de 8 às 18 e na Sexta de 8 às 17.

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the NYSE (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible and human. Our impact has been recognised by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About The Role

Being a Model Auditor at Nubank is different from being a traditional auditor. In a digital bank driven by data, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence our audit function also embraces technology to assess risks predictively and continuously. This position is fundamental to Nu’s success. You will be part of the Internal Audit team, focusing on Financial Risks (Credit, Market, Liquidity and Capital). Your primary goal will be to provide assurance on Nubank’s financial models.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluating and critiquing risk models (including statistical and Machine Learning models), from their conception, development and validation to their ongoing monitoring.
  • Applying knowledge of mathematics and statistics to analyse the robustness, performance and adherence of these models.
  • Executing audit tests using data analysis, exploring large volumes of data to identify risks, biases or control failures.
  • Leading technical discussions with stakeholders (such as Data Scientists, Engineers and the Risk team) and communicating audit findings clearly, objectively and constructively (both verbally and in writing).
  • Preparing audit reports and following up on the implementation of action plans to remediate identified vulnerabilities.

Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge in mathematics and statistics and experience applying these concepts to analyse or build models (whether in data science, credit, finance or related fields).
  • Practical experience with data analysis. While you don’t need to master a specific language (like Python or SQL), you must have experience in extracting, manipulating and analysing data to generate insights.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Able to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms to various audiences.
  • Analytical and problem‑solving profile, with strong critical‑thinking skills to break down complex problems and propose solutions.
  • Organised and detail‑oriented, without losing sight of the big picture.
  • Previous experience or knowledge in Internal Audit, Internal Controls or Risk Management (especially Credit Risk or Market Risk) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of the financial market, credit products or fintechs is a plus.

  • Gym Partnerships
  • 30 days of paid vacation

você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de auxiliar de serviços de loja . buscamos pessoas que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa , bom de gente e bom de jogo .

quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? vem pra FARM!

  • executar rotinas relacionadas à limpeza e organização de toda a loja;

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar atividades de compliance tributário direto e indireto, incluindo planejamento, análise, conciliações, ajustes e entrega de obrigações fiscais, garantindo precisão, conformidade legal e integração com os times de contabilidade, tesouraria, operações e demais impactados e/ou fornecedores de dados;
  • Liderar as atividades que demandem contato com autoridades fiscais, auditores externos e monitoramento do ambiente externo, conduzindo auditorias, fiscalizações, reuniões externas com IBP e demais associações, gerenciando contingências, provisões e recuperações tributárias;

  • Monitorar mudanças legislativas e interagir com IBP para avaliação de riscos e planos de mitigação;
  • Liderar iniciativas de capacitação e disseminação de conhecimento tributário, fortalecendo a cultura de compliance e integração entre áreas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Direito ou Contabilidade - MBA, mestrado e/ou certificação CPA será um diferencial;

  • Sólido domínio em PowerPoint, para traduzir dados complexos em apresentações claras e estratégicas, influenciando stakeholders e apoiando decisões alinhadas à estratégia corporativa;
  • 15 anos ou mais de experiência com conformidade de tributos fiscais diretos e indiretos e comprovada expertise em tax accounting, para liderar discussões estratégias de planejamento tributário e financeiro, promovendo otimização da carga fiscal e geração de valor;
  • É necessário experiência com Óleo e Gás;
  • É necessário ter experiência com sistemas ERP, incluindo implantação;
  • Profissional com perfil analítico e visão estratégica, orientada a soluções e resultados, atuando com responsabilidade e liderança colaborativa e equilibrando múltiplas prioridades em ambientes desafiadores e multiculturais;
  • Influencia stakeholders e conduz iniciativas voltadas à conformidade tributária, mitigação de riscos e otimização da carga fiscal, alinhadas aos objetivos e à estratégia corporativa;
  • Líder proativo, com forte senso de protagonismo e responsabilidade sobre os resultados e mindset de melhoria contínua, capaz de transformar obstáculos em resultado, aplicando soluções criativas para otimizar processos tributários e fortalecer compliance e gerar valor.

  • Realizar o recebimento de medicamentos e materiais entregues nas unidades, efetuando o recebimento conforme procedimento operacional padrão estabelecido pela companhia, utilizando instrumento adequado para tal processo;
  • Executar o processo de entrada de notas fiscais no SAP conforme procedimento interno padronizado, com eficiência e dentro dos tempos e movimentos preconizados;
  • Exercer processo de armazenamento dos materiais e medicamentos recebidos conforme boas práticas de armazenamento e procedimentos internos, mantendo os insumos em condições adequadas de uso;
  • Realizar diariamente o processo de dispensação de medicamentos e materiais em atendimento a prescrições médicas ou demais requisições, efetuando todas as etapas descritas em procedimento operacional padrão da atividade, garantindo assim que os medicamentos e materiais solicitados sejam dispensados corretamente, evitando erros de dispensação;
  • Executar o processo de devolução de materiais e medicamentos recolhidos nos postos assistenciais e centro cirúrgico conforme procedimento operacional previamente estabelecido;
  • Realizar diariamente a reposição dos endereçamentos com medicamentos e materiais, realizando todas as etapas descritas em procedimento operacional padrão da atividade, visando garantir a disponibilidade e localização dos medicamentos e materiais, além de realizar todos os atendimentos necessários para reabastecimento das farmácias satélites e setores assistenciais;
  • Realizar diariamente o processo de unitarização de medicamentos e materiais efetuando todas as etapas descritas em procedimento operacional padrão da atividade, visando assegurar que os procedimentos e legislações estejam sendo cumpridas;
  • Verificar mensalmente o prazo de validade dos medicamentos e materiais e anotar em formulário específico para que os farmacêuticos acompanhem os produtos com prazo de validade expirada ou próximo ao vencimento;
  • Realizar diariamente processo de contagem de medicamentos controlados, conforme recorrência e processos corporativamente estabelecidos;
  • Realizar diariamente a contagem dos medicamentos e materiais da curva ABC, anotando na planilha de contagem o saldo no físico e em sistema informatizado, visando garantir o controle de estoque destes insumos contribuindo para acurácia de estoque. Participar da equipe de inventários sempre que solicitado;

  • Realizar a entrega de insumos previamente separados pelas farmácias e almoxarifado para diferentes destinos internos no hospital, desde postos de enfermagem até farmácias satélites;
  • Efetuar diariamente o controle de temperatura (geladeira e ambiente) e controle de umidade, verificando a temperatura e umidade nos termômetros e termohigrômetro e anotando na ficha de controle, visando garantir a temperatura ideal para armazenamento de medicamentos e materiais;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos equipamentos utilizados diariamente, devendo informar ao farmacêutico qualquer necessidade de manutenção ou troca destes, a fim de manter os equipamentos em condições de uso;
  • Zelar diariamente pela limpeza e organização do setor de farmácia e almoxarifado, realizando as atividades diárias de forma que a limpeza e organização sejam mantidas, visando manter o setor limpo e organizado;

description: Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives. Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager. Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards. Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development. Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed. CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager. Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required. Team Development Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start. Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement. Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements. Commercial Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
